title: AI Park Design Challenge – Al Safa 2 Park Redesign
description: Workflow for the Dubai Municipality AI Design Challenge: human-centred design, AI tools, concept & preliminary design stages.

children.label: Design Challenge Brief & Team Assembly
children.description: Review TOR, deliverables, and budget. Assemble a multidisciplinary team and select AI tools.

children.label: TOR & Deliverables Analysis
children.description: Interpret required deliverables, AED 35M budget, 15,000 m² site.

children.label: Team & AI Tool Selection
children.description: Form team; select AI platforms (Midjourney, RunwayML) and simulation tools (ENVI-met, AnyLogic).

children.label: Redesign Justification
children.description: Identify shortcomings of the existing park and set strategic objectives aligned with Dubai 2040.

children.label: Existing Park Condition Audit
children.description: On-site inspection: ageing infrastructure, shading, accessibility gaps.

children.label: Stakeholder & Community Aspirations
children.description: Interviews and sentiment analysis to identify safety, comfort, and inclusivity gaps.

children.label: Data Collection
children.description: Gather site, user, microclimate, and utility data using LiDAR, surveys, and GIS.

children.label: Topography & LiDAR Survey
children.description: UAV-based LiDAR capture of contours, canopy heights, hardscape.

children.label: User Demographics & Intercept Surveys
children.description: On-site interviews (n=300) capturing usage patterns and accessibility needs.

children.label: Comprehensive Analysis & Synthesis
children.description: AI-augmented SWOT, spatial suitability, and thermal comfort studies.

children.label: GIS Multi-Criteria Spatial Suitability
children.description: Weighted overlay in ArcGIS Pro for planting, play, and quiet zones.

children.label: Thermal Comfort & Microclimate Baseline
children.description: ENVI-met simulation to pinpoint UTCI hotspots at peak summer hours.

children.label: Concept Ideation (AI-Augmented)
children.description: Generate and refine multiple design concepts using generative AI.

children.label: Three Concept Scenarios (A, B, C)
children.description: Oasis, Green Spine, and Urban Living Room — AI-enhanced mood boards.

children.label: Draft AI Methodology Report
children.description: Document AI tools, workflows, and their influence on each concept.

children.label: Scenario Testing & Performance Simulation
children.description: AI-driven simulations for microclimate, pedestrian flow, cost, and sustainability.

children.label: Microclimate & Solar Optimisation
children.description: Ladybug + ENVI-met scenario testing; AI-suggested tree placement and shading.

children.label: Preliminary Cost & Value Engineering
children.description: ROM costing per scenario, aligned with AED 35M budget.

children.label: Preliminary Design Development
children.description: Elaborate the selected concept into a coordinated preliminary design.

children.label: Detailed Masterplan & Spatial Organisation
children.description: CAD drafting: zoning, hierarchy, functional relationships.

children.label: Material & Landscape Palette
children.description: Durable, sustainable materials with AI-aided life-cycle assessment.

children.label: Final Submission Package
children.description: Produce all required deliverables per Schedule 2.

children.label: Design Narrative & AI Methodology Report
children.description: Vision, sustainability, and AI workflow — 20-30 page PDF booklet.

children.label: Final Quality Check & Upload
children.description: Cross-check deliverables against Schedule 2; upload by 15 Aug 2026.
